scope: read-only Meta Ads real-read foundation; no Meta mutation, no real Meta call in tests, no Supabase write/migration applied

token_policy: token is read only into backend memory
token is never sent to browser
token is never passed as subprocess argument
token is never written to Supabase, fixture, log or report

opaque_account_reference.resolution_rule: backend re-reads /me/adaccounts using the local token, resolves the opaque handle internally, and rejects unknown references
opaque_account_reference.browser_map_policy: browser never receives or stores a raw account-id map

endpoints.purpose: discover accessible Meta ad accounts with opaque references and sanitized metadata
read-only preflight for one opaque account reference; returns counts, capability states, freshness and sanitized errors; persists nothing
prepare/summarize synchronization without persistence; Supabase write remains blocked until separately authorized
read last in-memory preview receipt when available

adapter_contract.pagination: all pages are read up to the configured safety limit; cursor loops and duplicate objects fail safely
adapter_contract.failure_rule: remote incomplete read occurs before repository transaction and cannot mark objects absent or erase last good projection

insights_schema.actions_policy: actions are stored as separate rows with action_type, value, attribution_window, object_level and date range; not flattened into metric columns

security_guards: localhost + macOS guard on local router
GET-only adapter; no mutate endpoint added
no raw Meta payload returned or persisted
